text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"NM-002","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N4","page":1,"quote":"TOLERANCE NOTE :- 1) ALL H7 HOLES C.D SHOULD BE CONTROLLED WITHIN±0.02. / IT7 2) ALL HOLES,TAP & COUNTER BORE C.D, 3) SHOULD BE CONTROLLED WITHIN ±0.2."},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D33","page":1,"quote":"H7"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D36","page":1,"quote":"H7"}],"comment":"Note N4 states that all H7 hole center distances must be controlled within ±0.02 mm, but the general machining tolerances table specifies ±0.2 mm for dimensions in the 30–120 mm range (where these hole spacings fall), creating a contradiction.
